name: VFX — Respawn / Materialización de Tanque
generation_strategy: 3 frames individuales → script ensambla spritesheet horizontal 576×192

frames.role: Particles converging — partículas entrando al centro
frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX tank respawn/materialization frame 1 of 3, top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant cool cartoon FX, cyan-white energy, Brawl Stars quality. Converging particles: 14-16 small bright glowing dots arranged in a large circle, each dot with a motion trail pointing INWARD toward the center — like energy particles being summoned and pulled toward center. Dots are bright cyan-white (#00EEFF) with a soft cyan glow. The trails are short streaks pointing inward. Center is mostly empty, particles are at the ring edge. Cool cyan-white palette, magical teleportation feel. NO orange/fire colors. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, outward explosion, fire, orange, warm colors, background, text, watermark

frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX tank respawn frame 2 of 3, top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant cool cartoon FX, cyan-white peak flash. Peak materialization flash: a large bright circular burst — pure white glowing center fading to bright cyan, an expanding bold ring of cyan-white energy radiating outward. 6-8 short cyan sparkle rays around the ring edge. Bright and bold, maximum energy — the tank has just materialized. Cool cyan-white palette (#00EEFF + white). NO fire, NO orange. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, fire, orange, warm, scattered particles inward, background, text, watermark

frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX tank respawn frame 3 of 3 (final), top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant cool cartoon FX fading. Dissipating ring: a large thin expanding cyan ring nearly at the canvas edge, fading to transparent, center completely empty. 4-6 small faint cyan dot residuals scattered near the ring. Mostly transparent, nearly gone. Same cool cyan palette (#00EEFF). NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, dense, bright center, fire, orange, background, text, watermark
